phases.name: Analysis & Understanding
phases.description: Examined the current getBoxPrefix() function at ui/html/js/main.js:4077. Root cause confirmed: the function splits the SVG element ID by '_' and then filters to keep only numeric segments after the first numeric part. This loses non-numeric hierarchical segments (like 'l1', 'l2'). Example: SVG element ID 'id_1_l1_1_g' was being incorrectly extracted as '1_1' instead of the correct 'id_1_l1_1'. This caused blacklisting to fail because the wrong IDs were being referenced.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Current getBoxPrefix() implementation documented and root cause confirmed
SVG element ID patterns analyzed with concrete examples (id_1_l1_1_g, id_1_l2_3_g, etc.)
Edge cases and variations in ID formats identified

phases.name: Parsing Logic Design
phases.description: Designed a simplified parsing algorithm that removes only the trailing '_g' suffix from SVG element IDs while preserving all hierarchical segments. The algorithm: (1) checks if ID is null/empty and returns it as-is, (2) checks if ID ends with '_g', (3) if yes, removes the last 2 characters, (4) returns the result. This approach is much simpler than the original and correctly preserves hierarchical structure. Test cases designed and validated: 'id_1_l1_1_g' -> 'id_1_l1_1', 'id_1_l2_3_g' -> 'id_1_l2_3', 'box_1_g' -> 'box_1', 'id_1_l1_1' -> 'id_1_l1_1' (no suffix), empty string -> empty string, non-_g suffixes preserved.

acceptanceCriteria.text: New parsing algorithm designed and documented with pseudocode
Test cases defined for various ID formats (hierarchical, flat, with/without suffixes)
Edge cases identified and algorithm handles them correctly
Algorithm preserves backward compatibility with simple numeric IDs

phases.name: Implementation
phases.description: Replaced the getBoxPrefix() function in ui/html/js/main.js (lines 4077-4087) with the new simplified parsing logic. The new implementation: (1) checks if ID is null/empty, (2) removes the trailing '_g' suffix if present, (3) returns the result. The change is minimal (from 11 lines to 18 lines with documentation comments), focused, and does not affect other functionality. All references to getBoxPrefix() throughout the codebase (at lines 49, 1975, 2032, 2050, 2086, 3272, 4112, 4114, 4127, 4515) will now receive correctly extracted box IDs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: getBoxPrefix() function rewritten with new parsing logic
Function handles various SVG element ID formats without errors
Code changes are minimal and focused only on ID extraction
No unintended side effects on other ID extraction operations

phases.name: Verification & Validation
phases.description: Created and ran comprehensive test suite validating the fixed getBoxPrefix() function. All 7 critical test cases passed: (1) 'id_1_l1_1_g' -> 'id_1_l1_1' (main bug scenario), (2) 'id_1_l2_3_g' -> 'id_1_l2_3', (3) 'id_1_1_g' -> 'id_1_1', (4) 'box_1_g' -> 'box_1', (5) 'id_1_l1_1' (no suffix) -> 'id_1_l1_1', (6) empty string -> empty string, (7) non-_g suffixes are preserved. The fix correctly addresses the reported issue where blacklisting 'Master Node 1' or 'VM 1' would incorrectly blacklist 'id_1_1' or 'id_1_2'. With this fix, the correct hierarchical IDs will be extracted and blacklisting will work as intended.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test scenario loads successfully with fixed code
Blacklisting 'Master Node 1' correctly hides only that box, not 'id_1_1' or 'id_1_2'
Blacklisting 'VM 1' works as expected without side effects
No regressions observed in other UI functionality

knownLimitations: This fix assumes SVG element IDs always end with '_g' suffix for group elements. If the SVG rendering layer changes the suffix pattern in the future, this function may need updating.
The fix addresses the quick fix approach only and does not implement the long-term solution of storing data-box-id attributes in SVG elements as mentioned in the brainstorm.
Manual testing is recommended in the browser with the provided test scenario URL to verify blacklisting works correctly with real mixins before deployment.
